anomaly: im-chat 服务持续报 'outbox scan error'(RedisSystemException)

ground_truth.root_cause: 本地 Redis 3.2.100 不支持 ZPOPMIN 命令(Redis 5.0 引入);OutboxService 每 5s 用 ZPOPMIN 扫描发件箱,命令被拒(RedisCommandExecutionException: ERR unknown command ZPOPMIN)导致 outbox scan error 持续
ground_truth.solution: 升级 Redis 到 >= 5.0(架构声明 7.x);或改造 OutboxService 用兼容方案(ZRANGEBYSCORE+ZREM 或 Lua 脚本)
ground_truth.evidence: OutboxService: outbox scan error; Caused by: io.lettuce.core.RedisCommandExecutionException: ERR unknown command ZPOPMIN
